mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any statistical test for which the distribution of the test statistic under the null hypothesis can be approximated by a normal distribution."
Z-test A Z-test is any statistical test for which the distribution of the test statistic under the null hypothesis can be approximated by a normal distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the flatter one with the longer tails."
The t-distribution is the flatter one with the longer tails.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to indicate how reliable an estimate is, and it is calculated from the observed data."
The confidence interval is used to indicate how reliable an estimate is, and it is calculated from the observed data.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an estimate, based on sample data, of a population parameter. 3.2 Sample A sample is thus a part of the population under study selected so that inferences can be drawn from it about the population."

Sample statistics -A sample statistic is an estimate, based on sample data, of a population parameter. 3.2 Sample A sample is thus a part of the population under study selected so that inferences can be drawn from it about the population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of selecting individuals (single items) from a population."
Sampling on the other hand is the process of selecting individuals (single items) from a population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a procedure that gives each of the total sampling units of the population an equal and known non zero probability of being selected."
Simple random sampling is a procedure that gives each of the total sampling units of the population an equal and known non zero probability of being selected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of making decisions using data from a scientific study."
A statistical hypothesis test is a method of making decisions using data from a scientific study.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expression by which you may calculate a typical value of a dependent variable say Y, on the basis of the values of independent variable(s)."
Regression equation is an expression by which you may calculate a typical value of a dependent variable say Y, on the basis of the values of independent variable(s).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to sequence of observations that gives information on how data has been behaving in the past."
Time Series Defined Time series refers to sequence of observations that gives information on how data has been behaving in the past.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the joint probability distribution of a sample of n values of random variables."
The likelihood function is the joint probability distribution of a sample of n values of random variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most popular models used in statistical tests of hypothesis."
The normal curve is one of the most popular models used in statistical tests of hypothesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the opposite of interval estimation."
Point estimation is the opposite of interval estimation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the true value of a population attribute."
Population parameter - A population parameter is the true value of a population attribute.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any statistical test in which the test statistic follows a student's t distribution if the null hypothesis is supported."
T-test A t-test is any statistical test in which the test statistic follows a student's t distribution if the null hypothesis is supported.
